integrity: At fixed household count and total, Gini ranking reduces exactly to an integer pairwise-distance sum and coefficient-of-variation ranking to an integer squared-deviation sum. Every positive integer partition through the claimed cutoff is exhaustively enumerated, and all 762 admissible within-slice profile pairs are compared with exact arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The sharp cutoff assumes equal household count, equal total income, and strictly positive integer incomes. Allowing zero incomes or continuous rescaling changes the finite-resolution question. The statement is ordinal and does not select a normatively preferred inequality measure.
title: Twelve income units are the sharp positive-grid Gini–CV reversal boundary
